page: Vultr vbm-6c-32gb is a dedicated bare-metal server powered by an Intel Xeon E-2286G processor based on the x86_64 architecture. The platform provides 6 physical cores and 12 hardware threads operating at a base frequency of 4.0 GHz, backed by 12 MB of L3 cache. Memory configuration includes 32.0 GB of RAM, offering approximately 2.67 GB per virtual thread. For persistent storage, the system is provisioned with a bundled 1920 GB local solid-state drive, accompanied by one complimentary public IPv4 address without integrated GPU acceleration.

Benchmark results highlight solid single-thread compute capabilities, driven by the 4.0 GHz clock rate. In compression workloads, the server demonstrates strong efficiency, achieving 35.51 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression and 13.91 GB/sec in single-threaded bzip3 decompression, both ranking in the top quartile. The system recorded a Geekbench single-core score of 1729.0 and a multi-core score of 7230.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 15132.19 and a top-tier PassMark memory score of 3453.69.

Resource tradeoffs appear in uncached memory streaming and large-model compute. Potentially uncached large-block memory bandwidth drops into the bottom 25%, measuring 32.51 GB/sec for reads and 14.71 GB/sec for writes. Similarly, inference on a medium 7B parameter LLM yielded modest speeds of 25.26 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 7.38 tokens/sec for token generation. However, operations utilizing cache, such as small-block read bandwidth at 851.86 GB/sec, maintain average throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the physical bare-metal profile provides direct hardware access without virtualization overhead or noisy-neighbor contention. With 1.92 TB of integrated local SSD storage and a high clock speed, the instance is well matched for dedicated web serving, CI/CD compilation pipelines, Redis caching clusters, and single-tenant database deployments.
description: Vultr vbm-6c-32gb is a dedicated bare-metal server configured with a 6-core, 12-thread Intel Xeon E-2286G processor running at 4.0 GHz on x86_64 architecture. Supported by 32.0 GB of system memory and 12 MB of L3 cache, the hardware includes a bundled 1920 GB local SSD without GPU hardware. Performance metrics demonstrate competitive single-core execution, yielding strong results in single-threaded compression and decompression, alongside a PassMark memory score in the top ten percent. Tradeoffs include lower throughput during uncached 256 MB memory write and read passes, which also restricts execution rates on multi-billion parameter language models. The lack of hypervisor overhead combined with dedicated local solid-state storage makes this server a solid deployment platform for compile workloads, transactional databases, static web serving, and in-memory caches.
